reigns.note: Founder of Ephyra, the city later called Corinth — craftiest of men, whose son Glaucus begat Bellerophon.
Son of Sisyphus and king of Ephyra; father of Bellerophon, slayer of the Chimera.
King of Corinth in the Oedipus saga — not the Ithacan suitor Polybus nor any other homonym; his neatherds found the exposed infant on Cithaeron and Periboea raised him as their son.
King of Corinth in the Jason–Medea episode — distinct from Creon of Thebes (`creon`); betrothed Glauce to Jason and perished in Medea's poisoned robe.
